title: Pablo Exclusive Pear Nicotine  Pouches - 30mg / Pouch
description: Pablo Pear Nicotine Pouches deliver the light, crisp flavour of juicy pear alongside a powerful 30mg of nicotine per pouch. It’s a fresh and subtly sweet profile that stands out for its simplicity and smooth finish. Each pouch is slim and soft, designed to sit under the upper lip where it dissolves slowly, releasing nicotine with no smoke, vapour, or fuss. Ideal for discreet use in any setting. With Pablo’s reputation for bold strengths and unique flavours, Pear offers a more understated option that’s still rich in satisfaction. How to Use: 1 Place a pouch between your upper lip and gum for a consistent nicotine release for up to 60min 2 Place the used pouch in the designated top compartment of the pack. 3 Dispose of the pouch. PLEASE DO NOT CHEW OR SWALLOW POUCH Please Note: These nicotine pouches are 30mg of nicotine per pouch.
